source_note: Workbook states that these nominal values were extracted from src/fairino_description/urdf/fairino16_v6.urdf, rather than independently measured on this individual robot.
convention: Craig modified DH: Rx(alpha_{i-1}) Tx(a_{i-1}) Rz(q_i + theta_offset_i) Tz(d_i)
angle_conversion_note: The spreadsheet records alpha as 0, +90, or -90 degrees. The source URDF uses approximate 1.5708 rad; this JSON uses exact pi/2 as the intended angle.
scope: Six-axis robot chain ends at wrist3_link; no grinder/tool correction is included. The separate 0.106 m wrist3_link-to-flange fixed transform in the capture URDF is used only for frame reconciliation.
